title: Kuvumelekile Ukukhuphela Umxholo? Imigaqo Nelungelo Lokushicilela
description: Kuvumelekile ukukhuphela umxholo wemidiya yoluntu? Qonda umahluko wokugcina wena nokupapasha kwakhona, imvume, ukukhankanya umdali, ne-copyright.
photoCaption: Khuphela ukuze kube kokwakho, hayi ukupapasha kwakhona.
body:
Ukukhuphela iividiyo okanye iifoto kwimidiya yoluntu ngoku kulula kakhulu. Kodwa kuvela umbuzo obalulekileyo: ngaba ngokwenene kuvumelekile ukukhuphela umxholo wemidiya yoluntu, kwaye yeyiphi imigaqo yokuziphatha nemigaqo yelungelo lokushicilela (copyright) ekufuneka uyiqwalasele? Eli nqaku liyichaza ngokubanzi nangendlela elula, ukuze ugcine umxholo ngoxolo ngaphandle kokwenzakalisa abadali.

Inqaku: eli nqaku liqulethe ulwazi ngokubanzi, ayingcebiso yezomthetho. Kwimibuzo ethile yezomthetho, kungcono uthethe negqwetha okanye umcebisi wamalungelo epropathi yengqondo.

Umdali ngumnini womsebenzi wakhe

Yonke ividiyo, ifoto, umculo, okanye umzobo ofakwe kwimidiya yoluntu wenziwe ngumntu othile. Ngokuqhelekileyo, ilungelo lokushicilela lalo msebenzi lelomntu owenzileyo, hayi lalowo uwubukelayo okanye owukhuphelayo. UMzantsi Afrika, njengamanye amazwe amaninzi, nawo unomthetho olawula ilungelo lokushicilela.

Oku kuthetha ukuba xa umxholo ubonwa nangubani na, akuthethi ukuba ukhululekile ukusetyenziselwa nantoni na. Ukuvuleleka eluntwini akufani nokungabi nalo ilungelo lokushicilela.

Imigaqo yokukhuphela umxholo: ukubukela wena xa uthelekisa nokupapasha kwakhona

Kukho umahluko omkhulu phakathi kokugcina umxholo ukuze uwonwabele wena nokuwusasaza kwakhona.

Ukusetyenziswa kobuqu

Imizekelo kukugcina ividiyo yeresiphi ukuze uyibukele xa upheka ngaphandle kwe-intanethi, ukugcina isifundo ukuze ufunde, okanye ukugcina ividiyo oyithandayo ukuze uyibukele kwakhona. Awuthi loo msebenzi ngowakho kwaye awuwusasazeli abanye.

Ukupapasha kwakhona (repost)

Kwahlukile ukuba ufaka umxholo womnye umntu kwi-akhawunti yakho, ingakumbi ngaphandle kwemvume, ngaphandle kokukhankanya umdali, okanye ukuze wenze inzuzo. Isenzo esinjalo sinokwaphula amalungelo omdali nemigaqo yeqonga. Iziphumo zinokwahluka, ukusuka ekususweni kokuthunyelweyo, ekuthintelweni kwe-akhawunti, ukuya kwiingxaki zomthetho.

Imigaqo phambi kokupapasha kwakhona umxholo womnye umntu

Ukuba ufuna ukwabelana kwakhona ngomsebenzi womntu othile, landela la manyathelo alula:

  1. Cela imvume. Thumela umyalezo kumdali uze uchaze ukuba uza kuwusebenzisa phi kwaye ngantoni loo mxholo.
  2. Linda impendulo ecacileyo. Ukuthula akuthethi ukuvuma. Ukuba akukho mpendulo, kungcono ungawufaki.
  3. Khankanya umdali. Chaza igama okanye i-akhawunti yomdali ngokucacileyo, hayi ukuyifihla kwindawo ekunzima ukuyibona.
  4. Sukususa isazisi somdali. Xa upapasha kwakhona ngemvume, qinisekisa ukuba igama okanye i-akhawunti yomdali isabonakala, umzekelo kwinkcazelo yokuthunyelweyo.
  5. Hlonipha isigqibo somdali. Ukuba umdali uyala okanye ucela ukuba umxholo ususwe, yenza oko akucelayo.

Ukuba iqonga lineempawu zalo zokwabelana, njengokwabelana ngelinki okanye uphawu lwe-repost ngaphakathi kwe-app, loo ndlela idla ngokuba yeyona ikhuselekileyo kuba umdali uqhubeka ekhankanywa.

Soloko ujonga imigaqo yeqonga ngalinye

Iqonga ngalinye lemidiya yoluntu linemigaqo yalo yenkonzo elawula indlela umxholo onokusetyenziswa nokwabelwana ngayo. Imigaqo inokwahluka ukusuka kwelinye iqonga ukuya kwelinye, kwaye inokutshintsha ngokuhamba kwexesha. Phambi kokusebenzisa umxholo womnye umntu nangayiphi na indlela engaphaya kokubukela wena, thatha ixesha ufunde imigaqo yelo qonga.

Umxholo ofuna ukulumka ngakumbi

  • Umculo neengoma. Umculo osevidiyweni unokuba ngowomnye umntu, hayi owomenzi wevidiyo.
  • Umxholo obonisa abanye abantu. Hlonipha ubumfihlo babantu ababonakala kwividiyo okanye kwifoto, ingakumbi abantwana.
  • Ukusetyenziswa korhwebo. Ukusebenzisa umxholo womnye umntu kwiintengiso, ekuthengiseni, okanye kwiitshaneli ezihlawulelwayo ngaphandle kwemvume kuyingozi kakhulu.

Yintoni indima ye-I Need Save?

I-I Need Save sisixhobo sokugcina okuthunyelweyo okuvulelekileyo okuvela kumaqonga afana ne-TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, ne-X (Twitter) kwisixhobo sakho. Umxholo wabucala, umxholo ofuna ukungena, nomxholo othintelwe ngokommandla awunakukhutshelwa. Iifayile zidluliselwa ngqo zisuka kwiqonga lokuqala ziye kwisixhobo sakho kwaye azigcinwa kwiseva ye-I Need Save.

Esi sixhobo senzelwe ukwenza kube lula ukusetyenziswa kobuqu, umzekelo ukubukela ngaphandle kwe-intanethi. Uxanduva lwendlela umxholo osetyenziswa ngayo emva kokukhutshelwa lusekumsebenzisi. Ngoko ke, khuphela ukuze kube kokwakho, uze ucele imvume kwaye ukhankanye umdali phambi kokupapasha kwakhona.

Ukuba usaqala, izikhokelo ezithi indlela yokukhuphela iividiyo nee-Reels ze-Instagram kunye nethi apho iifayile ezikhutshelweyo zikhoyo zinokukunceda.

Umgaqo olula ekulula ukuwukhumbula: ukugcina ukuze ubukele wena kwahlukile ekusasazeni. Ukuba ufuna ukusasaza, cela imvume uze ukhankanye umdali.

Imibuzo ebuzwa rhoqo

Ngaba ukukhuphela ividiyo ukuze ndiyibukele mna kusoloko kuvumelekile?

Imigaqo inokwahluka ngokwelizwe, iqonga, nohlobo lomxholo. Ngokwemigaqo yokuziphatha, ukugcina ukuze ubukele wena kwahluke kakhulu ekusasazeni kwakhona. Ukuze uqiniseke ngokusemthethweni, thetha nengcali.

Ukuba sele ndimkhankanyile umdali, ndingapapasha kwakhona ngaphandle kwemvume?

Akunjalo ngokuqinisekileyo. Ukukhankanya umdali luhlobo lwentlonipho, kodwa akufani nemvume. Kungcono uqale ucele imvume kumdali.

Ndingawusebenzisa umxholo womnye umntu ukuthengisa?

Ukusetyenziswa korhwebo ngaphandle kwemvume kuyingozi kakhulu. Qhagamshelana nomnini womsebenzi ukuze ucele imvume okanye ilayisenisi, uze uthethe negqwetha ukuba kuyimfuneko.
